title: Everything your store organization needs to sell, stock and report
subtitle: When your organization is onboarded, your admin gets POS Terminal, products, inventory, staff permissions, discounts, restaurant floor tools and 30 reports in PDF and Excel - ready for daily store work.
body: Rathin POS is built for the organization you run: restaurants, cafes, QSR, grocery, supermarket and retail. Your org admin controls catalog, cashiers, terminals and reports for that store. Multi-store groups run each organization separately under one platform.
badge_text: For organization admins and store teams

title: Designed around your organization
subtitle: Super admin creates your organization and org admin. From there, your team runs the full store stack.
body: Organization admins manage products, categories, inventory, POS machines, staff, customers, discounts, tables and taxes (for restaurants), invoices and the full Report Hub. Cashiers sell on POS Terminal. Finance exports the reports your business needs every day.

title: Modules available to your organization
subtitle: After onboarding, org admins and permitted staff use these tools inside the app - the same names you see below.

title: Industries we serve
subtitle: Same product, configured per organization business type.

title: POS Terminal
subtitle: Live counter billing for restaurants, QSR, grocery and retail
body: Open a bill, add items from menu tiles or barcode, apply line discounts, choose order type (dine-in, takeaway, delivery, pickup, retail), assign a POS machine, and complete checkout with cash, card, UPI or wallet. Split payments, tendered cash and change, and automatic invoice print are built in.

bullets: Barcode scan and menu-tile add to cart
Order types: dine-in, takeaway, delivery, pickup, retail
Split payments across cash, card, UPI, wallet
Hold bill, cancel bill, kitchen order ticket (KOT)
extra_json.growth: Shorter queues, fewer billing errors, and cleaner end-of-day cash reconciliation.

title: Products and Menu
subtitle: Catalog for every vertical - menu items, grocery SKUs and barcodes
body: Create products with price, cost, tax rate, unit (pcs, kg, litre), SKU, barcode, category, image, initial stock and low-stock threshold. Track inventory per item or sell by weight. Edit anytime without downtime.

bullets: Price, cost price and tax % per product
SKU, barcode and unit of measure
Category link and product image upload
extra_json.growth: Faster menu launches and accurate pricing across outlets.

title: Categories
subtitle: Menu sections, aisles and product groups
body: Organize the catalog into categories with color, image, sort order and active status. Cashiers filter the POS by category for faster billing.

extra_json.growth: Cashiers find items faster during peak hours.

title: Inventory and Stock
subtitle: Live on-hand quantities, low-stock filters and signed adjustments
body: See every product with on-hand quantity and health (healthy, low, out). Adjust stock with movement types: purchase, return, waste, transfer, opening and adjustment. Notes and user trail stay on each movement.

bullets: Purchase, waste, return, transfer, opening, adjustment
Stock reduces automatically on tracked sales
extra_json.growth: Fewer stock-outs and less dead inventory.

title: Orders and Sales
subtitle: Full order lifecycle from open to completed
body: List and filter orders by status. Hold an open order for later. Cancel with reason. Send kitchen order tickets. Checkout with multi-payment and invoice generation. Daily order numbers and sales codes stay unique per organization.

extra_json.growth: Kitchen and counter stay aligned; fewer lost orders.

title: Invoices and Bills
subtitle: Printable receipts with brand snapshot and reprint tracking
body: Every completed sale can produce an invoice with organization snapshot, line items and payments. Reprint from the invoice list; printed count is tracked for control.

extra_json.growth: Professional bills and audit-ready reprint history.

title: Discounts and Offers
subtitle: Coupons, seasonal windows, item and category offers
body: Create organization promotions with display name, coupon code, scope (cart, product, category, coupon, seasonal, super-admin org offer), percentage or fixed value, min order, max cap and validity window. Super admin can also push platform offers to a target organization. Preview discount against a cart before go-live.

bullets: Coupon codes and seasonal date windows
Min subtotal and max discount cap
Platform offers targeted to an organization
extra_json.growth: Run campaigns without manual cashier math.

title: Tables, Waiters and Tax
subtitle: Restaurant floor and bill configuration
body: Manage dining tables (name, capacity, area, occupied flag), waiters (name, code, phone), and tax rates (name, code, rate, default). Configure bill header, footer, KOT enable, table management, waiter enable and currency symbol per organization.

bullets: Dining tables with capacity and area
extra_json.growth: Floor service and tax-ready bills for F&B brands.

title: POS Machines
subtitle: Register every counter device
body: Create POS terminals with name and code per organization. Select the active machine on the POS Terminal so sales and reports stay attributed to the right counter.

bullets: Sales by terminal in Report Hub
extra_json.growth: Multi-counter stores know which machine sold what.

title: Customers
subtitle: Walk-in and registered buyers
body: Maintain customer records linked to the organization. Use them on bills and review customer-wise sales in Report Hub.

extra_json.growth: Recognize regulars and track their value.

title: Staff and Permissions
subtitle: Org admins create team members with module access for their organization
body: Organization owners create managers, cashiers and staff for their store only. Grant module permissions so each person sees POS, inventory or reports as needed - without sharing the owner login.

extra_json.growth: Safe delegation without sharing owner login.

title: Team Directory
subtitle: Users list for the active organization
body: Browse team members, roles and activity status. Keep the directory clean as people join or leave.

extra_json.growth: HR and ops know who has access today.

title: World Currencies
subtitle: AED base with daily exchange rates
body: Base currency is AED. Maintain active world currencies and daily rates. Convert amounts through AED for planning and multi-market operations. Super admin maintains rates for the platform.

bullets: Convert tool for any pair via AED
extra_json.growth: One system for multi-country rollouts and clear FX.

title: Organizations
subtitle: How stores are onboarded - then handed to org admin
body: Platform super admin creates each organization (restaurant, cafe, grocery, supermarket and more), sets currency and timezone, and can create the organization owner admin. That admin then runs the store. Super admin can switch active organization to support any tenant.

bullets: Business types for F&B and retail
Active tenant switch for super admin

subtitle: Super admin edits the public website live
body: Update hero, modules, reports list, FAQs, careers, social links and every landing section with text and images. The public site reads the CMS bundle on each visit.

extra_json.growth: Marketing updates without a developer release.

title: Org Module Access
subtitle: Control which modules each organization may use
body: Super admin grants module access per organization. Combined with staff permissions, this keeps platform and store roles clear.

extra_json.growth: Right people, right screens, right data.

title: Platform Users

body: Super admin creates platform-level operator users and grants module permissions for platform work such as onboarding and CMS.

extra_json.growth: Internal team can support customers safely.

subtitle: Command center for platform and store
body: Organization users see revenue today, invoices, products, low stock, terminals, customers, 7-day sales, payment mix, top products and recent orders for their store. Super admin sees the full network of organizations.

bullets: Revenue, invoices and open orders today
Low stock and top products for your org
extra_json.growth: Your organization starts every day knowing sales, stock risk and counter health.

title: Questions from organization owners and admins

items.q: What does my organization get after onboarding?
items.a: Your org admin gets Dashboard, POS Terminal, Products, Categories, Inventory, Orders, Invoices, Report Hub (30 reports), Discounts, Tables/Waiters/Tax (for restaurants), POS Machines, Customers, Staff Permissions, Team Directory, Currencies view and Settings for that organization.
Platform super admin creates the organization and can create the organization owner admin. That admin then runs day-to-day store operations and staff.

items.q: Can one organization run restaurant and grocery?
items.a: Each organization has a business type (restaurant, cafe, fast food, grocery, kirana, supermarket, retail, bakery, other). Restaurant tools like tables, waiters and KOT are available for F&B orgs; barcode and high-SKU inventory suit grocery and supermarket orgs.

items.q: How many reports can my organization export?
items.a: 25 organization reports in Report Hub (cashier summary, daily sales, item-wise, low stock, tax collected, and more), each as PDF and Excel. Platform-level reports are for super admin across all organizations.

items.q: How do staff permissions work inside my organization?
items.a: Organization owners create staff and grant module permissions (for example POS only, or inventory plus reports). Super admin can also control which modules the organization may use.
Yes. Register POS Machines for the organization and select the terminal on POS Terminal so sales and reports stay attributed correctly.

items.q: What payments work on the organization POS?
items.a: Cash with tendered amount and change, card, UPI and wallet, including split payments on one bill.

items.q: Does inventory update when we sell?
items.a: Yes for products with inventory tracking on. Org admins can also adjust stock for purchase, waste, return, transfer, opening and manual adjustment.
Platform super admin CMS. Organization users focus on store modules after login.
Org admin signs in, adds products and a terminal, opens POS Terminal, completes a bill, then uses Report Hub for daily close.
